subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album support be exposed by automatic grouping of existing mediaUrls, by a new explicit media-group action/parameter, or deferred in favor of current sequential sends?
rationale: The request adds user-visible Telegram message-tool behavior across multiple delivery surfaces, so the permanent API shape and fallback policy need maintainer intent before an automated fix is safe.

options.title: Group existing mediaUrls when eligible
options.body: Use the current durable mediaUrls path and call sendMediaGroup only for Telegram-groupable 2-10 media sets, falling back to sequential sends otherwise.

options.title: Adopt an explicit album action
options.body: Rework the linked draft PR's explicit send-media-group action shape if maintainers want albums to be opt-in instead of automatic.

options.title: Document sequential sends for now
options.body: Defer album grouping and document that Telegram multi-media output currently sends separate messages.

recommendation.title: Group existing mediaUrls when eligible
recommendation.body: Use the current durable mediaUrls path and call sendMediaGroup only for Telegram-groupable 2-10 media sets, falling back to sequential sends otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and is the strongest current routing signal for the central Telegram files.
